title: Features & Tweaks
description: A Minecraft Datapack, that tweaks & overhauls some features of minecraft while also adding New Features that keep minecraft feel new!
body:
### _The Resource Pack is downloaded along the Datapack, to Install it Put the ZIP File in the resource pack folder & the world's datapack folder!_

**Explore & Encounter:**
Discover brand new variants of mobs like Wolves, Cows, Pigs, Cats, Chickens, and Frogs. Be careful about the Poison Dart Frogs. even **~~Herobrine~~** himself is back!. The adventure doesn't stop there, as you can jump into entirely Custom Dimensions waiting to be explored.

**Building & Crafting:**
New blocks: mix up potions in the **Cauldron** to brew mixed potions, cook meals in the **Cooking Pot**, and teleport between floors fast and effortlessly using **Elevator blocks**, Plus several **Crafting Tweaks** make your life a little easier.

**Gears & More:**
Craft yourself **Custom Armors & Items with some that has abilities**, There is also Custom Enchantments and a new variant of it is the **Blessings**, including new Curses. You can also decorate your world's look and sound with a selection of **New Custom Paintings and Music Discs**.
